scope: Diagnostic initramfs on the authorized primary device; no Android filesystem image flashed.

attempts.boot_request: One HOME_SCREEN request after fresh primary identity match.
attempts.host_observation: Repeated high-speed USB descriptor/address errors (-71); no diagnostic ACM console.
attempts.user_observation: Patched LK splash, then black screen with backlight on.
attempts.recovered_expdb: No diagnostic pstore rings; vendor records include earlier pre-flash fastboot activity. The recorded kernel phase is set by LK before Linux entry.

attempts.change: USB clock parent selection and bounded UDC discovery in the initramfs.
attempts.boot_request: One HOME_SCREEN request after fresh primary CID/chip/capacity match.
attempts.host_observation: Same descriptor/address errors (-71); no ACM in either observer window.

recovery.expdb: Only the four-byte BOOT_STEP field changed. All existing record descriptors and payloads remain unchanged; no new mainline pstore records.
recovery.para_boot_para_seccfg: Full fresh reads match their pre-boot hashes.
recovery.ram_capture: Six fixed ranges read successfully with exact identity checks before and after each region.
recovery.printk: Invalid geometry and pointers; state, infos and text are all 0xff. No finalized descriptors or admitted log records.
recovery.memory_marker: The only non-0xff descriptor bytes are <<<RAM_RW>>> at physical 0x42000000; the selected DA also contains this literal. Its writer and full affected range were not traced.
recovery.preloader_log: Validated header and bounds describe 13273 bytes of preloader output and zero LK bytes. The log reports cold boot, disabled DDR retention, fresh log allocation and a jump to the DA.
recovery.conclusion: Recovery did not preserve evidence that locates the preceding Linux boot attempt. Linux execution remains unconfirmed.

attempts.change: Pstore cleaner teardown fix and an opt-in diagnostic worker that verifies an expdb checkpoint before poweroff.
attempts.boot_request: One HOME_SCREEN request after fresh primary identity match.
attempts.host_observation: Repeated USB descriptor/address errors (-71); no identified diagnostic gadget or ACM console during the 180-second observation.
attempts.recovery: Fresh-cache read-only recovery listener started; expdb capture pending a primary reconnect.

limits: DA shutdown acknowledgment is not Linux-entry evidence.
LK deliberately stops scanout; the screen observation does not locate the failure.
USB errors alone cannot identify which software stage is active.
Persistent mainline logging to expdb has not been demonstrated.
Private captures retain device identifiers and are not published.
The earlier offline build records describe their original pre-device-test milestones.
